evidence.note: TodoWrite used at start, mid, and end as a persistent checklist of milestones — present but coarse (only 3 updates over ~250 steps).
Repeated full-suite and 'Total pass rate' runs across the whole horizon; continuously re-measures the aggregate score rather than assuming, ending with a 'Verify no failures' check.
Systematically categorizes remaining failures (non-validation / numeric / SIMD / malformed) and repeatedly lists 'all remaining failures' — an effective running ledger of what's still open by family.

When stuck on specific SIMD assertions (lines 41/50/53) it localizes to individual lines and disassembles the wasm to understand, rather than re-debugging in circles — detects and breaks potential thrashing.
Works family-by-family (memory, call_indirect, block, call, global, SIMD load_lane), tracking which family is current and what remains after each.

reasoning: The agent continuously reconciles the aggregate pass rate (many full-suite reruns) against categorized remaining-failure lists and closes families one at a time, localizing individual stuck assertions rather than thrashing — behavior between the level-5 and level-8 anchors. It falls short of a clean 8/10 because the explicit checklist is sparse (3 TodoWrites), and there is no visible moment of catching a cross-family regression or concretely quantifying the gap to 1.0; the category triage substitutes for a precise ledger. This places it at a 7.
